raw_html: [[Shockwave#Overwhelming Shockwave|Overwhelming Shockwave]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Shockwave#Overwhelming Shockwave|Overwhelming Shockwave]]:''' This legendary weapon resonates with incredible power. On a Vorpal strike that is confirmed as a critical hit, it releases a Shockwave that does tremendous Sonic damage to all foes. Furthermore, the enemy that the shockwave is released on is [[Dazed]] from the force of the blast.
